testSuite: Golden Fork Chatbot - Black Box Test Cases
description: 50 test cases simulating real customers who know NOTHING about the menu. Each tests a different scenario the chatbot must handle intelligently.

testCases.input: I am vegetarian but no onion no garlic
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend vegetarian dishes after checking ingredients for onion/garlic. Thai Red Curry Vegetables has no onion/garlic. Should NOT say 'I don't see any'.

testCases.input: I love meat but no beef and pork
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend chicken, duck, seafood, or lamb dishes. Pan-Seared Duck, Herb-Crusted Salmon, Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps are all valid.

testCases.input: What about something that is light not too heavy as I'm not feeling well
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest salads, light appetizers, soups, or simple grilled items. Caesar Salad, Beet Salad, Grilled Broccolini are good options.

testCases.input: How about halal pork
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should politely explain pork cannot be halal, then offer halal-friendly alternatives (chicken, lamb, seafood).

testCases.input: What are today's top 3 selling items
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend signature/popular dishes (Ribeye, Duck, Salmon, Lobster Risotto) or chef's choice if available.
mustNotContain: I don't have information on today's top-selling

testCases.input: Vegetarian but I have allergen to capsicum and peanuts
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should find vegetarian dishes without capsicum/bell pepper and peanuts. Check ingredients carefully. Burrata, Caesar Salad, Wild Mushroom Fettuccine are options.

testCases.input: I'm really hungry, what's good here?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend 2-3 popular hearty dishes across categories with prices.

testCases.input: What can I get for under $15?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should list items under $15: Crispy Calamari ($14.99), Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps ($13.99), Beet Salad ($12.99), Caesar Salad ($11.99), sides, beverages.

testCases.input: It's our wedding anniversary, we want something really special
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend premium items: Grilled Ribeye, Lobster Risotto, Pan-Seared Duck with wine pairings.

testCases.input: We are a group of 4, one vegetarian, one allergic to shellfish, can you suggest a mix?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest a variety: vegetarian option, non-shellfish mains, shared appetizers, noting which is safe for whom.

testCases.input: I want chicken, what do you have?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should find Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps. May also mention Caesar Salad with added chicken per chef's note.

testCases.input: I love seafood, show me your best
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Herb-Crusted Salmon, Lobster Risotto, Crispy Calamari with descriptions and prices.

testCases.input: I want something spicy, hit me with your hottest!
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend spicy-flagged items: Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps, Thai Red Curry Vegetables, Grilled Broccolini.

testCases.input: I can't handle any spice at all, what's mild?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend non-spicy dishes and explicitly avoid items marked [Spicy].

testCases.input: What desserts do you have?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should list all desserts: Chocolate Lava Cake, Crème Brûlée, Vegan Coconut Panna Cotta with descriptions.

testCases.input: I'm vegan, do you have any desserts for me?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Vegan Coconut Panna Cotta specifically.
mustNotContain: I don't see any vegan desserts

testCases.input: I'm getting the ribeye, what wine goes with it?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Cabernet Sauvignon or Malbec as listed in ribeye pairings.

testCases.input: What's in the carbonara?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should describe Spaghetti Carbonara ingredients: guanciale, egg yolk, Pecorino Romano, black pepper.

testCases.input: I want something with no dairy, no gluten, and no nuts
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should find: Thai Red Curry Vegetables (GF, vegan, no nuts), Grilled Broccolini (GF, vegan, no nuts).
mustNotContain: I don't see anything that matches

testCases.input: What would you recommend for a 5 year old?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest kid-friendly items: fries, simple pasta, maybe lemonade. Use common sense.

testCases.input: 我想吃海鲜
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should understand Chinese for 'I want to eat seafood' and recommend seafood dishes.

testCases.input: 寿司はありますか
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should understand Japanese 'do you have sushi' and explain no sushi but suggest similar seafood options.

testCases.input: What's the difference between the duck and the ribeye?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should compare Pan-Seared Duck ($38.99) with Grilled Ribeye ($52.99) — flavors, preparation, price.

testCases.input: Is the ribeye enough for two people to share?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should mention it's a 16oz steak and give honest advice about sharing.

testCases.input: What's the healthiest thing on your menu?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend salads, grilled fish (salmon), grilled broccolini, Thai Red Curry Vegetables.

testCases.input: I want comfort food, something warm and cozy
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest: Wild Mushroom Fettuccine, Spaghetti Carbonara, Lobster Risotto, or Thai Red Curry.

testCases.input: No fish, no shellfish, what meat options do you have?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend: Grilled Ribeye, Pan-Seared Duck, Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps, Spaghetti Carbonara.

testCases.input: Can you suggest a starter and main course combo?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should pair an appetizer with a main, e.g. Burrata + Ribeye or Calamari + Salmon.

testCases.input: Plan a 3-course meal for me — starter, main, dessert
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend one from each category with logical pairings.

testCases.input: I'm craving pasta, what are my options?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should list: Spaghetti Carbonara and Wild Mushroom Fettuccine with descriptions.

testCases.input: Any vegetarian pasta?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Wild Mushroom Fettuccine (marked vegetarian).

testCases.input: I'm allergic to dairy, what can I eat?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should find dairy-free items: Thai Red Curry Vegetables, Grilled Broccolini, Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps, etc.

testCases.input: I have an egg allergy, what's safe?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should check allergens lists and avoid items with eggs (Calamari, Caesar, Carbonara, Chocolate Lava Cake). Recommend items without eggs.

testCases.input: I don't know what I want
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should ask about preferences (meat/seafood/vegetarian) and suggest popular items to get started.
mustNotContain: I can't help if you don't know

testCases.input: Just looking for drinks, what do you have?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should list beverages and wines: Lemonade, Thai Iced Tea, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay.

testCases.input: Any non-alcoholic drinks?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Fresh Squeezed Lemonade and Thai Iced Tea.

testCases.input: I'm pescatarian, what works for me?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend seafood + vegetarian items: Salmon, Lobster Risotto, Calamari, plus vegetarian options.

testCases.input: I'm on a low carb diet, what can I eat?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest protein-focused dishes without heavy carbs: Ribeye with veggies, Salmon, salads, grilled broccolini.
mustNotContain: I don't see any low carb

testCases.input: I need something high in protein, I just worked out
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend protein-rich: Ribeye (16oz steak), Salmon, Duck Breast, chicken dishes.

testCases.input: I'm on a first date, what's impressive but not too messy?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend elegant dishes: Duck Breast, Salmon, Lobster Risotto. Avoid messy items like lettuce wraps.

testCases.input: What does the chef recommend?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should mention chef's choice items if available, or recommend signature dishes.
mustNotContain: I don't have information on chef

testCases.input: I need a gluten-free main course
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should list GF mains: Duck Breast, Ribeye, Salmon, Lobster Risotto, Thai Red Curry Vegetables.
mustNotContain: I don't see any gluten-free mains

testCases.input: I'm allergic to shellfish and dairy, what mains do you have?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should exclude shellfish (calamari, lobster) and dairy items, find safe options like Thai Red Curry Vegetables, Thai Chicken Lettuce Wraps.

testCases.input: What sides can I add to my steak?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Truffle Parmesan Fries and Grilled Broccolini.

testCases.input: Actually, does that have garlic in it?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should check the ingredients of the previously discussed dish and give accurate answer about garlic content.

testCases.input: What's your most expensive dish? And cheapest?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should identify Grilled Ribeye ($52.99) as most expensive and suggest cheapest options (Lemonade $4.99 or Broccolini $8.99).

testCases.input: I love mushrooms, anything with mushrooms?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should find: Wild Mushroom Fettuccine, Grilled Portobello Stack, and Pan-Seared Duck (wild mushroom risotto).

testCases.input: Can the Thai curry be made without any alcohol?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should check ingredients — Thai Red Curry Vegetables doesn't contain alcohol. Confirm it's safe.

testCases.input: Which dishes travel well for takeaway?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should use common sense: curry, pasta, sides travel well. Steak less so. Give thoughtful recommendation.

testCases.input: Last time I had the salmon and loved it. What else would I like?
testCases.expectedBehavior: Should suggest similar dishes: other seafood (Lobster Risotto), or dishes with similar flavor profile. Use pairings logic.
